description: Dallas-based hyperscale data center developer with 51 campuses and 6.4+ GW of operational and planned capacity across the US and Latin America, known for its patented water-saving cooling. Acquired at a ~$40B enterprise value by AIP, MGX and BlackRock's GIP (closed July 2026) — the largest data center deal on record — with $5B of additional growth capital committed.

TeraWulf's 790-acre AI data center campus on a former aluminum smelter site in Hawesville, Kentucky, with existing power and fiber infrastructure. Anthropic signed a 20-year, ~$19B lease (up to ~$33B with extensions) for ~401 MW of critical IT capacity, ramping to full capacity by early 2028.

Meta's first Canadian data center: a 1 GW, AI-optimized facility in Sturgeon County, Alberta (its 33rd globally and largest outside the US), representing a CAD $13B (~$9.2B USD) investment. Power comes via a long-term tolling agreement with Pembina Pipeline's planned Greenlight Electricity Centre gas plant; groundbreaking was July 2026.

Vinod Khosla's venture firm is raising a family of new funds targeting up to $5.5B — roughly $1B for seed, $2B for early-stage and $2.5B for an opportunity fund — its largest fundraise ever, with most capital aimed at early-stage AI startups. Form D filings were made in July 2026; amounts are targets, not a completed close.

The alternative asset management arm of Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Investment Company. In July 2026 it completed the transfer of Mubadala's ~$25B credit portfolio onto its platform under a long-term management agreement, opening the credit business to third-party investors for the first time, with Mubadala committing $4.65B of incremental capital to grow it.

North America's largest standalone battery-storage independent power producer, with ~6.5 GW of operating, under-construction and contracted capacity and a 20+ GW development pipeline across the US and Canada. Brookfield agreed in July 2026 to acquire it from Blackstone Energy Transition Partners at a ~$7B enterprise value (~$3B equity).

A $1.75B-equivalent syndicated loan package (USD and EUR term loans from a four-bank group) backing SoftBank's $5.375B acquisition of ABB's industrial robotics division — a ~7,000-employee business with $2.3B of 2024 revenue that SoftBank is buying as part of its 'Physical AI' push; the deal is expected to close mid-to-late 2026.

South Korea's dominant internet company (search, commerce, cloud), now building sovereign AI infrastructure. In July 2026 NVIDIA announced a planned $1B investment for a ~4.5% stake, alongside up to $9B of Brookfield funding, to expand NAVER's NVIDIA DSX AI factory at its GAK Sejong data center from 55 MW to 200 MW by 2028, with a stated path to 1 GW.

A code-named Greenoaks deal vehicle: a Delaware LP formed in 2026 and renamed from 'Greenoaks Generations Founders LP' per its amended Form D, which reports $576.5M raised from 11 investors (first sale June 26, 2026). Promoters are Greenoaks partners Neil Mehta and Benjamin Peretz; the underlying deal target is undisclosed.

Moraga, California semiconductor startup developing a new class of AI memory using 3D-stacked ferroelectric technology that puts compute logic directly adjacent to weight storage, targeting the memory bottleneck in AI accelerators. Selected by the Commerce Department in July 2026 for up to $245M in CHIPS Act R&D incentives (letter of intent), the second-largest of seven awards.

target: Greenoaks Prime Radiant Founders Offshore LP
description: The offshore sleeve of Greenoaks' code-named 'Prime Radiant' deal vehicle, renamed from 'Greenoaks Generations Founders Offshore LP' per its amended Form D, which reports $115.5M raised from 4 investors (first sale June 26, 2026). Runs parallel to the $576.5M onshore Greenoaks Prime Radiant Founders LP; the underlying deal target is undisclosed.

target: Prometheus project (Idaho National Laboratory and partners)
description: A DOE Genesis Mission initiative led by Idaho National Laboratory with a 32-partner consortium (Oak Ridge, Argonne, Sandia, plus X-energy, TerraPower, Oklo, NVIDIA and AWS among 20+ industry partners) using AI to design, license, build and operate nuclear reactors — targeting 2x schedule compression and >50% cost reduction. Awarded a $60M three-year Phase II grant in July 2026, the largest single Genesis Mission award, with $200M+ in industry cost share.

Financial-management software startup ('QuickBooks for the real economy') founded in 2020 by Mackenzie Burnett, Dan Schlosser and Jeff Anders — bookkeeping, payments and cash management for farms, ranches, trucking, construction and property businesses, now 8,000+ customers. Raised a $30M Series B in August 2026 led by Lachy Groom with Thrive Capital and Thomson Reuters Ventures participating, bringing total funding to $59M.

target: Savannah River Site AI data center
description: A planned 1 GW AI data center with ~2 GW of dedicated on-site generation (natural gas transitioning to nuclear) on federal land at the DOE/NNSA Savannah River Site in South Carolina. NNSA selected site operator Amentum in July 2026 to negotiate a phased land-lease public-private partnership; no lease award is final yet and no dollar figures have been disclosed.

AI research lab founded in April 2026 by Ritankar Das (CEO) with Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus as co-founders, training computer-use models (its Hive-32B) that automate office workflows like insurance claims processing. Reported in talks to raise $100M at a ~$1B valuation, with up to $50M in signed customer contracts and 25+ hires from OpenAI, DeepMind and Meta.

Paris-based frontier AI lab known for high-performance open-weight models and its Le Chat assistant, positioned as Europe's leading independent AI company. In July 2026 Microsoft announced an expanded strategic partnership described as a multibillion-dollar commitment, covering European GPU capacity, Mistral models in Microsoft Foundry/Copilot Studio, and sovereign deployments for regulated industries.

Brookfield's AI infrastructure framework agreement with the French government, announced at the February 2025 Paris AI Action Summit at €20B and expanded to €30B (confirmed in Brookfield's Q2 2026 results) to enable French sovereign AI infrastructure — mostly data centers built and operated by Brookfield portfolio company Data4, including campuses at E-Valley Cambrai and Escaudain in Hauts-de-France, plus power and network investments.

target: Andreessen Horowitz Fund X-B - AI Applications, L.P.
description: A newly registered Andreessen Horowitz venture fund vehicle dedicated to AI applications — the 'X-B' sleeve of a16z's Fund X family and successor to Fund IX - AI Applications. Its initial Form D (filed July 16, 2026) reports an indefinite offering with no sales yet, signaling a16z is raising its next AI applications fund; fund size is undisclosed.
